question: $2x+y+6=0$ এবং $4x+2y+2=0$ রেখাদ্বয়ের মধ্যবর্তী দূরত্ব কত একক?
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ$\;\;\;4\mathrm x+2\mathrm y+2=0\;\\\Rightarrow2\mathrm x\;+\mathrm y+1=0\;;\\\;\;\;\;\;2\mathrm x\;+\mathrm y+6=0\;\;;\\\mathrm{মধ্যবর্তী}\;\mathrm{দূরত্ব}\;=\frac{\begin{vmatrix}6-1\end{vmatrix}}{\sqrt{2^2+1^2}}=\frac5{\sqrt5}=\sqrt5$

subject: Math 1st Paper
question: $\overset-A=2\overset\wedge i+\overset\wedge j+\overset\wedge k\;,\;\overset-B=\overset\wedge i-\overset\wedge j+2\overset\wedge k$ হলে, $\overset-A\;$ এর উপর $\overset-B\;$ এর লম্ব অভিক্ষেপ কত?
explanation: ব্যাখ্যাঃ$\overrightarrow{\mathrm B}=\;\widehat{\mathrm i}-\widehat{\mathrm j}+2\widehat{\mathrm k}\\\widehat{\mathrm b}=\frac{\overrightarrow{\mathrm B}}{\left|\overrightarrow{\mathrm B}\right|}=\frac{\widehat{\mathrm i}-\widehat{\mathrm j}+2\widehat{\mathrm k}}{\sqrt{1+1+4}}=\frac1{\sqrt6}(\widehat{\mathrm i}-\widehat{\mathrm j}+2\widehat{\mathrm k})\\\mathrm{লম্ব}\;\mathrm{অভিক্ষেপ}\;=\overrightarrow{\mathrm A}.\widehat{\mathrm b}\;=(2\widehat{\mathrm i}+\widehat{\mathrm j}+\widehat{\mathrm k}).\frac1{\sqrt6}(\widehat{\mathrm i}-\widehat{\mathrm j}+2\widehat{\mathrm k})\\=\frac1{\sqrt6}\left[(2\widehat{\mathrm i}+\widehat{\mathrm j}+\widehat{\mathrm k}).(\widehat{\mathrm i}-\widehat{\mathrm j}+2\widehat{\mathrm k})\right]\\=\frac1{\sqrt6}\lbrack2.1+(1)(-1)+1.2\rbrack=\frac3{\sqrt6}=\frac3{\sqrt3\sqrt2}=\frac{\sqrt3}{\sqrt2}=\sqrt{\frac32}$
